prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1010; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, waiting to turn left.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The airbags didn't go off, but my car was pushed into the intersection.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?

A: Not right away. I sat there for a minute because I felt dizzy and my neck was really stiff. The other driver came over and asked if I was okay.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They did a CT scan and told me I had a concussion. I've had headaches, trouble focusing on screens, and I get tired really fast.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?

A: Yes. My doctor has me resting from work for now and I have a follow-up appointment scheduled next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I've never been in an accident like this before. I want my medical bills and lost wages taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
